name: What are common signs of a bathroom leak?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a bathroom leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a bathroom leak include water stains on ceilings or walls, peeling paint or wallpaper, warped flooring, a musty odor, or visible mold growth. High water bills without increased usage can also indicate a hidden leak. Addressing these signs promptly can prevent more extensive damage to your home's structure and contents.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for water stains, peeling paint, warped floors, mold, or musty smells. An unexplained high water bill can also indicate a hidden leak.
